description: This is a test class for the WizardLanguagePackFragment in the Android application, using Robolectric for unit testing. It verifies the behavior of the fragment when a language pack is installed or missing, including UI interactions and dialog prompts.

classes.name: WizardLanguagePackFragmentTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for WizardLanguagePackFragment, testing UI behavior and interactions.

methods.name: tearDownLanguagePack
methods.description: Resets the default locale to US after each test.

methods.description: Creates a new instance of WizardLanguagePackFragment for testing.

methods.name: testPageCompleteIfStartedWithLanguagePackInstalled
methods.description: Verifies that the fragment correctly indicates completion when a language pack is installed.

methods.name: testHappyPath
methods.description: Simulates the scenario where the language pack is missing, tests UI click handling, and verifies dialog prompt.
